learning_objective: 🎯 Let's have fun together! Today we will play traditional games like Tag and Hide-and-Seek that kids have loved for years.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: One person is the 'denner'. Run fast and dodge quickly so the denner cannot touch you!
Find a safe and clever spot to hide while the seeker counts. Stay very quiet so you don't get caught!

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Statue Dance Game
fun_activity.instructions: Play your favorite music and dance crazily! When the music stops, you must freeze like a statue. If you move, you are out!

quick_recap: ⭐ Traditional games keep us healthy, active, and very happy.
⭐ Always play fair and make sure no one gets hurt while running.
